verdict.rationale: monday.com documents an expressive GraphQL API plus SDKs for automating processes, and says every agent can be run and managed programmatically 'from your own code, anywhere you need it.' Event subscriptions and webhooks, scoped keys and the hosted MCP endpoint round out the headless control. Missing for 10: a documented CLI or CI-runner integration (e.g. GitHub Actions or pipeline examples), explicit service-account or token guidance for CI contexts, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
